title: Phase 3: Quick-Cast Arcane Dock & Talent Bar
requirements: Persistent Arcane Dock & Talent Bar for memorised spells and character abilities
Authentic DCSS spell and ability icons/tiles using cell_renderer or tileinfo
Accurate MP costs, piety/breath requirements, and failure rates with disabled state when insufficient MP
Correct keyboard shortcut sequences with standardized .keybind-badge hints
Mouse-click casting initiating native DCSS targeting (e.g. z + letter, a + letter)
Clean empty state with memorise prompt when no spells are memorised
Responsive layout without overlapping the Chronicle, Action Dock, or Right Sidebar HUD
